deploybot: Terraform apply started for infra/gpupool/dc7 (prod)
deploybot: run_id=run-1972003456 commit=4f7a9c2 branch=main tag=release/dc7-gpupool-v1.12
deploybot: plan summary: +12 to add, ~3 to change, -0 to destroy. expected drift checks: none. change window=2026-03-20T22:00Z

marie: picking up canary nodes for drain now, will annotate nodes with canary=true then cordon+drain one by one
marie: command: `kubectl cordon node-gpudc7-04 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets node-gpudc7-04`

devin: quick question — does this apply include the kernel module bump (nv-kmod v2.3)? any additional kube-restarts?
marie: yes it includes kmod bump but we scoped it to driver-hotpatching path, should avoid node restarts. estimated per-node disruption < 2m

rafael: tagging @oncall-bot to run post-canary smoke once the first two nodes are back up
oncall-bot: Smoke test job queued: smoke-382 (target: gpupool-dc7-canary). ETA ~6m after canary ready

devin: note: pinning infra image at sha: `registry.redwood/infra-agent@sha256:9b3e5e` per the rollout playbook
marie: acked, pin applied in tfvars (agent_image_sha=9b3e5e)

deploybot: Apply step: running `terraform apply -auto-approve` in infra/gpupool/dc7 (sensitive outputs suppressed)

deploybot: Apply completed successfully for run_id=run-1972003456
deploybot: 12 added, 3 changed, 0 destroyed
deploybot: outputs: gpupool_endpoint=https://dc7-gpu.redwood.net ready_count=48 canary_group=node-gpudc7-04,node-gpudc7-05

marie: canary nodes report ready, starting smoke verify logs now
marie: smoke logs: `gpu-init ok; agent connected; kv-cache warm`

oncall-bot: smoke-382 succeeded (0 failures). 99p latency baseline check: within threshold

aliya: seeing a short 95th->99th spike in inference latency for model-serving on canary ~30s after smoke green, filing quick ticket TKT-2147 to track
devin: ok let's hold rollout and not expand canary yet. revert plan prepared referencing tag release/dc7-gpupool-v1.11 if needed
rafael: agree. hold for 15m and monitor metrics (prometheus/gpupool-dc7)

marie: starting 15m hold window now @here :hourglass_flowing_sand:

[15 minutes pass — metrics watched]

aliya: after 10m the 99p spike attenuated but remains ~8% higher than baseline. conservative call: roll back agent image to previous sha and re-run small canary.
marie: rolling back agent_image_sha -> `6c2a1b` (release/dc7-gpupool-v1.11) and will kick a canary-only apply (no changes to pool count)

devin: please include the rollback rationale in the PR description and in the release notes. also coordinate with models team in case kv-cache warmup affected tails
marie: will open rollback PR and tag @models-team

deploybot: Terraform plan for rollback (run_id=run-1972003789) created: ~1 change (agent image pin revert). awaiting approval to apply
marie: applying rollback now `terraform apply -target=module.agent -var 'agent_image_sha=6c2a1b' -auto-approve`

deploybot: Rollback apply completed (run_id=run-1972003789). 0 added, 1 changed, 0 destroyed
deploybot: outputs: agent_image_sha=6c2a1b rollout_status=canary-reverted

devin: thanks, monitoring. will keep canary at 2 nodes for now and only expand when 24h stability observed
rafael: filing a short post-mortem note and adding to next infra retro agenda
aliya: adding perf traces and logs to TKT-2147 for root cause analysis

marie: closing thread — will follow up with PR link and release note blurb when ready :white_check_mark:
